instruction: flatten() in flatten.py is supposed to turn a nested dict into dot-path keys, but when a nested value is itself an empty dict, flatten() recurses into zero iterations and out.update({}) silently drops that key entirely instead of preserving it. Fix flatten() so an empty nested dict at any depth is kept in the output (as an empty-dict value at its dotted path) without breaking the existing tests in tests/test_flatten.py.
